reel.caption:
How much gold can you keep at home without trouble in a tax search?

Income tax search guidelines say jewellery up to 500 g for a married woman, 250 g for an unmarried woman and 100 g for a man isn't seized, even without papers.
These are guidelines, not a legal cap. You can hold more if you can show where it came from.
For anything above, keep purchase bills, inheritance papers and gift records.

Does your family keep the bills for its gold?

Sources: a business news explainer on gold-at-home rules (Apr 2026) and a brokerage news explainer on gold limits.

For education only. Not investment advice.
